patch_description: This redesign separates the solution into a persistent world model, strip-plan construction, per-turn reservation-aware action planning, BFS routing, and state synchronization. Humans are assigned to horizontal strips according to their initial row, while each internal separator remains split between neighboring strip owners. The planner uses BFS distances for selecting reachable construction positions, reserves walls planned for the current simultaneous turn, and no longer unnecessarily blocks humans from sharing movement destinations, which is legal and improves mobility.
